senses.gloss: f. (familia) the slaves in a household, family servants; frequ. divine agencies, ministers.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 1:15">Targ. Cant. I, 15</cite>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 5:6:2">Y. Sot. V, 20ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>איוב … ומגדולי פמילייא וכ׳</he> Job was one of Pharaoh’s servants and of the grandees of his household.
<cite ref="Chullin 7b:14">Ḥull. 7ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 67b:6">Snh. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>פ׳ של מעלה</he> the heavenly household, v. <cite ref="K01319"><he>כַּשָּׁף</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 16b">Ber. 16ᵇ</cite> sq. <he>שתשים שלים בפ׳ של מעלה ובפ׳ של מטה</he> let peace reign in the heavenly household and in the household here below (thy servants on earth).

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4">Num. R. s. 4</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 28:13">Gen. XXVIII, 13</cite>) <he>ראה המלך ופ׳ שלו וכ׳</he> he saw the King, and his attendants stood by him to guard him. Sifra K’dosh. beg.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 604:2">Yalk. Lev. 604</cite>, v. <cite ref="H01548"><he>חָקָה</he></cite>; a. fr.
